other_costs_pct.title: Other Costs Pct

discount_rate.title: Discount Rate
discount_rate.description: Used for NPV of unlevered and levered flows

reserve_psf_pa.title: Reserve Psf Pa
reserve_psf_pa.description: Recurring reserve per sq ft total NLA per year

target_ltv.title: Target Ltv
target_ltv.description: Max loan as % of purchase price

min_dscr.title: Min Dscr
min_dscr.description: If set, loan is also capped so Year 1 DSCR >= this

min_debt_yield.title: Min Debt Yield
min_debt_yield.description: If set, loan is also capped so Year 1 NOI / loan >= this

upfront_fee_pct.title: Upfront Fee Pct
upfront_fee_pct.description: % of loan amount, paid at closing

noi_basis.title: Noi Basis
noi_basis.description: forward = Year N+1 NOI, trailing = Year N NOI

asset_mgmt_fee_pct.title: Asset Mgmt Fee Pct
asset_mgmt_fee_pct.description: Annual fee, % of the chosen basis

asset_mgmt_fee_basis.title: Asset Mgmt Fee Basis
asset_mgmt_fee_basis.description: gav = annual value estimate (next-year NOI / exit cap rate); purchase_price = fixed on price; equity = initial equity

acquisition_fee_pct.title: Acquisition Fee Pct
acquisition_fee_pct.description: % of purchase price, paid at closing

divestment_fee_pct.title: Divestment Fee Pct
divestment_fee_pct.description: % of gross sale price, paid at exit

Fees.title: Fees
Fees.description: Fund / manager fees. Paid out of equity cash flow, reported separately as manager income.

renewal_probability.title: Renewal Probability
renewal_probability.description: Share of expiring area that renews

rent_free_months_per_year_new.title: Rent Free Months Per Year New
rent_free_months_per_year_new.description: Rent-free months per lease year, new leases

rent_free_months_per_year_renewal.title: Rent Free Months Per Year Renewal
rent_free_months_per_year_renewal.description: Rent-free months per lease year, renewals

commission_months_new.title: Commission Months New
commission_months_new.description: Leasing commission in months of rent, new leases

commission_months_renewal.title: Commission Months Renewal
commission_months_renewal.description: Leasing commission in months of rent, renewals

fitout_contribution_psf_new.title: Fitout Contribution Psf New
fitout_contribution_psf_new.description: Landlord fit-out contribution per sq ft, new leases only

LeasingAssumptions.title: LeasingAssumptions
LeasingAssumptions.description:
Steady-state leasing costs for the market-rent method.

Each year ``1 / avg_lease_term_years`` of the occupied area rolls. Of that, a share
``renewal_probability`` renews; the rest is re-let to new tenants. A rent-roll method will
replace this with lease-by-lease expiries.

rent_psf_pm.title: Rent Psf Pm
rent_psf_pm.description: Year 1 gross rent, per sq ft per month

vacancy.title: Vacancy
vacancy.description: Vacancy as % of gross potential rent

credit_loss.title: Credit Loss
credit_loss.description: Bad debt as % of rent after vacancy

MarketRevenue.title: MarketRevenue
MarketRevenue.description: Simple market-rent build: NLA x rent psf pm x 12, less vacancy and credit loss.

property_tax_rate.title: Property Tax Rate
property_tax_rate.description: SG non-residential rate: 10% of Annual Value

annual_value_year1.title: Annual Value Year1
annual_value_year1.description: IRAS Annual Value for Year 1 if known; grows in line with total GPR. If null, AV = av_to_gpr_ratio x total GPR (before vacancy)

av_to_gpr_ratio.title: Av To Gpr Ratio
av_to_gpr_ratio.description: AV as % of gross potential rent; strips the service-charge element

lease_years_remaining.title: Lease Years Remaining
lease_years_remaining.description: Remaining land lease at acquisition (leasehold only)

id.title: Id
id.description: Optional id; derived from the name if omitted

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Steps each side of the base value

recoveries_psf_pm.title: Recoveries Psf Pm
recoveries_psf_pm.description: Service charge / A&P billed on top of rent, psf pm (0 for gross leases)

turnover_rent_pct.title: Turnover Rent Pct
turnover_rent_pct.description: Turnover (GTO) rent as % uplift on base rent collected (retail)

opex_psf_pm.title: Opex Psf Pm
opex_psf_pm.description: Landlord operating costs (excl. property tax), per sq ft NLA per month

WaterfallTier.title: WaterfallTier
WaterfallTier.description:
Cash between the previous hurdle and ``up_to_irr`` (LP IRR) is split with a GP promote.

``up_to_irr = None`` means "everything above the last hurdle" and must be the final tier.
``gp_promote`` is the GP's extra share of the cash in this tier, on top of its pro-rata
co-invest share of the remainder.
